summary_en: One-year ruling for 2013: because 25 March 2013 falls on Monday of Holy Week, the solemnity of the Annunciation of the Lord is celebrated on 8 April 2013, Monday after the Second Sunday of Easter (Table of Liturgical Days and Normae n. 60). Declaration without protocol number or date.
excerpt: Cum anno 2013, die 25 martii incidat feria II Hebdomadae Sanctae, iuxta Tabulam dierum liturgicorum secundum ordinem praecedentiae dispositam et secundum n. 60 Normarum de Anno liturgico et de Calendario, sollemnitas Annuntiationis Domini celebrabitur die 8 aprilis, scilicet feria II post Dominicam II Paschae, sicut ex editione typica tertia Missalis Romani patet.

celebration.name_latin: In Conceptione Immaculata Beatae Mariae Virginis

excerpt: Cum anno 2013, die 8 decembris incidat Dominica II Adventus, iuxta Tabulam dierum liturgicorum secundum ordinem praecedentiae dispositam et secundum nn. 5 et 60 Normarum de Anno liturgico et de Calendario, sollemnitas Immaculatae Conceptionis Beatae Mariae Virginis celebrabitur die 9 decembris, feria II post Dominica II Adventus.

celebration.name_latin: Domini nostri Iesu Christi Summi et Aeterni Sacerdotis

summary_en: By decision of Benedict XVI communicated by the Secretariat of State on 14 June 2012, Episcopal Conferences that ask the Congregation may inscribe in their proper calendars the celebration of Our Lord Jesus Christ, Eternal High Priest, with the rank of feast on the Thursday after Pentecost (a movable date); circular letter of the Congregation to the presidents of the Conferences, published with the Latin texts. Recorded at general level because the indult is open to every Conference on request, not an insertion in the General Roman Calendar.
excerpt: mi è gradito comunicarLe che in data 14 giugno 2012 il Signor Cardinale Segretario di Stato (Prot. N. 194.519) mi ha trasmesso la decisione del Santo Padre di concedere alle Conferenze Episcopali, che ne faranno richiesta a questa Congregazione per il Culto Divino e la Disciplina dei Sacramenti, l’iscrizione nei rispettivi Calendari Propri della celebrazione di NOSTRO SIGNORE GESÙ CRISTO SOMMO ED ETERNO SACERDOTE con il grado di festa, il giovedì seguente la solennità di Pentecoste

celebration.name_latin: Domini nostri Iesu Christi Summi et Aeterni Sacerdotis

summary_en: Decree approving and declaring typical the Latin texts of the Mass, Liturgy of the Hours and Roman Martyrology elogium for the feast of Our Lord Jesus Christ, Eternal High Priest (Thursday after Pentecost), prepared for the use of the Episcopal Conferences that request it; the Martyrology entry is printed on p. 368. Recorded because it fixes the Martyrology text of a new feast; the text approval as such is otherwise outside the register.
excerpt: Haec porro Congregatio de Cultu Divino et Disciplina Sacramentorum, vigore peculiarium facultatum ab eodem Summo Pontifice ad hoc tributarum, textum latinum Missae, Liturgiae Horarum et Martyrologii Romani de DOMINO NOSTRO IESU CHRISTO SUMMO ET AETERNO SACERDOTE, prout in adiecto exstat exemplari, libenter probat et typicum esse declarat.

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is granted to the calendar of the Episcopal Conference of Tanzania on 22 October as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Tanzaniae: 22 octobris, Beati Ioannis Pauli II, papae, memoria ad libitum (13 iun. 2012; Prot. 196/12/L).

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is granted to the calendar of the diocese of Albacete (Spain) on 22 October as an optional memorial.

celebration.name_latin: Sanctus Alfonsus Maria de' Liguori, episcopus et Ecclesiae doctor

summary_en: St Alphonsus Maria de' Liguori, bishop and doctor of the Church, is celebrated on 1 August with the rank of feast in the archdiocese of Amalfi-Cava de' Tirreni (Italy).
excerpt: Amalphitani-Cavensis, Italia: 1 augusti, Sancti Alfonsi Mariae de’ Liguori, episcopi et Ecclesiae doctoris, festum (20 iun. 2012; Prot. 382/12/L).

excerpt: Arecibensis, Portus Ricus: 6 novembris, Beatorum Ferdinandi Llovera Puigsech, presbyteri, et sociorum, martyrum, memoria ad libitum (25 maii 2012; Prot. 246/12/L).

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is granted to the calendar of the diocese of Armenia (Colombia) on 22 October as an optional memorial.

excerpt: Buscoducensis, Nederlandia: 27 novembris, Sanctae Odae, virginis, memoria ad libitum (22 feb. 2012; Prot. 23/12/L);

summary_en: Blessed Eustachius van Lieshout, priest, is granted to the calendar of the diocese of 's-Hertogenbosch (Netherlands) on 30 August as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Buscoducensis, Nederlandia: [...] 30 augusti, Beati Eustachii van Lieshout, presbyteri, memoria ad libitum (18 ian. 2012; Prot. 25/12/L).

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is granted on 22 October with the rank of feast for the parish church to be built and dedicated to him at Urbanización Juan Pablo II – Avenida Teherán in the city of Caracas (archdiocese of Caracas, Venezuela); a single-church concession. The same protocol appears under Decreta varia (p. 380) as the permission to dedicate that church to him.
excerpt: Caracensis, Venetiola: 22 octobris, Beati Ioannis Pauli II, papae, festum in ecclesia paroeciali loci v. d. Urbanización Juan Pablo II – Avenida Teherán, in civitate caracensi exstruenda et eidem Beato dicata (5 mar. 2012; Prot. 897/11/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Georgius Popiełuszko, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: Blessed Jerzy (George) Popiełuszko, priest and martyr, is granted on 19 October with the rank of feast for the chapel to be built at Złocie in the parish of the Nativity of the Blessed Virgin Mary in the city of Kraków (archdiocese of Kraków, Poland); a single-chapel concession. The same protocol appears under Decreta varia (p. 381) as the permission to name that chapel after him.
excerpt: Cracoviensis, Polonia: 19 octobris, Beati Georgii Popiełuszko, presbyteri et martyris, festum in sacello loci v. d. Złocie paroeciae Nativitatis Beatae Mariae Virginis, in civitatae cracoviensi, exstruendo (25 apr. 2012; Prot. 1052/11/L)

excerpt: Mariborensis, Slovenia: 27 maii, Beati Aloysii Grozdè, martyris, memoria ad libitum (2 feb. 2012; Prot. 988/11/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Ioannes de Palafox y Mendoza, episcopus

excerpt: Mexicanae, Mexicum: 6 octobris, Beati Ioannis de Palafox y Mendoza, episcopi, memoria ad libitum (5 mar. 2012; Prot. 1031/11/L).

summary_en: Blessed Alojzij (Aloysius) Grozde, martyr, is granted to the calendar of the diocese of Novo Mesto (Slovenia) on 27 May as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Novae Urbis, Slovenia: 27 maii, Beati Aloysii Grozdè, martyris, memoria ad libitum (28 ian. 2012; Prot. 753/11/L);

celebration.name_latin: Beatae Krizina Bojanc, Antonia Fabjan et sociae, virgines et martyres

excerpt: Novae Urbis, Slovenia: [...] 15 decembris, Beatarum Krizina Bojanc, Antoniae Fabjan et sociarum, virginum et martyrum, memoria ad libitum (29 maii 2012; Prot. 1059/11/L).

excerpt: Pampilonensis et Tudelensis, Hispania: 6 octobris, Beati Ioannis de Palafox y Mendoza, episcopi, memoria ad libitum et 10 octobris, Beatae Mariae Catharinae Irigoyen Echegaray, virginis, memoria ad libitum (25 ian. 2012; Prot. 1125/11/L).

excerpt: Ravennatensis-Cerviensis, Italia: 12 octobris, Sancti Guidonis Mariae Conforti, episcopi, memoria (28 apr. 2012; Prot. 1006/11/L).

excerpt: Sancti Augustini, Civitates Foederatae Americae Septentrionalis: 11 octobris, Dominae Nostrae a Lacte festum (28 iun. 2012; Prot. 335/12/L).

excerpt: Suidniciensis, Polonia: Calendarium proprium (24 apr. 2012; Prot. 1071/11/L).

summary_en: For the diocese of Tarnów (Poland) the memorial of Blessed John Paul II, pope, may be transferred from 22 October to 25 October.
excerpt: Tarnoviensis, Polonia: Conceditur ut memoria Beati Ioannis Pauli II, papae, a die 22 octobris ad diem 25 eiusdem mensis tranferri valeat (28 feb. 2012; Prot. 1061/11/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Anna Maria Janer Anglarill, virgo

summary_en: Blessed Anna Maria Janer Anglarill, virgin, is granted to the calendar of the diocese of Urgell (Spain) on 11 January as an optional memorial.
excerpt: Urgellensis, Hispania: 11 ianuarii, Beatae Annae Mariae Janer Anglarill, virginis, memoria ad libitum (5 mar. 2012; Prot. 1183/11/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beatus Georgius Popiełuszko, presbyter et martyr

summary_en: Blessed Jerzy (George) Popiełuszko, priest and martyr, is granted to the calendar of the Military Ordinariate of Poland on 19 October as an optional memorial (listed under 'Alia', neither a diocese nor an institute).
excerpt: Ordinariatus Militaris in Polonia: 19 octobris, Beati Georgii Popiełuszko, presbyteri et martyris, memoria ad libitum (19 iun. 2012; Prot. 354/12/L).

summary_en: The proper calendar of the Institute of the Sisters of St Francis de Sales is approved.
excerpt: Instituti Sororum Sancti Francisci Salesii: Calendarium proprium (30 apr. 2012; Prot. 963/11/L).

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the town of Świdnica (diocese of Świdnica, Poland); a single-town patron. The town name is printed with a missing initial glyph ('widnica').
excerpt: Beatus Ioannes Paulus II, papa: Patronus caelestis urbis v. d. widnica; Suidniciensis, Polonia (22 feb. 2012; Prot. 1070/11/L).

summary_en: St Bartholomew the Apostle is confirmed as heavenly patron of the county (powiat) of Opoczno (diocese of Radom, Poland); a sub-diocesan territory. The county name is printed with a missing glyph ('Opoczy ski').
excerpt: Sanctus Bartholomaeus Apostolus: Patronus caelestis Provinciae v. d. Powiat Opoczy ski; Radomensis, Polonia (3 mar. 2012; Prot. 430/11/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo s.t. Nuestra Señora de Villaviciosa

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Nuestra Señora de Villaviciosa is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the association of those who minister to the sick of Córdoba (diocese of Córdoba, Spain); an association's patron.
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo s.t. Nuestra Señora de Villaviciosa: Patrona caelestis coetus infirmis ministrantium Cordubensis, Cordubencis, Hispania (7 mar. 2012; Prot. 44/12/L).

summary_en: Blessed Salomea, virgin, is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the town of Zawichost (diocese of Sandomierz, Poland); a single-town patron.
excerpt: Beata Salomea, virgo: Patrona caelestis urbis v. d. Zawichost, Sandomiriensis, Polonia (20 mar. 2012; Prot. 981/11/L).

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the town of Wadowice (archdiocese of Kraków, Poland); a single-town patron.
excerpt: Beatus Ioannes Paulus II, papa: Patronus caelestis urbis v. d. Wadowice; Cracoviensis, Polonia (2 apr. 2012; Prot. 1113/11/L).

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary of the Angels is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the parish of St Catherine of Alexandria in Rossiglione (diocese of Acqui, Italy); a single-parish patron.
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo Angelorum: Patrona caelestis paroeciae Sanctae Catharinae Alexandrinae, virginis et martyris in civitate Rossilione; Aquensis, Italia (30 apr. 2012; Prot. 82/12/L).

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the young faithful of the diocese of Huelva (Spain); a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Beatus Ioannes Paulus II, papa: Patronus caelestis iuvenum christifidelium dioecesis; Onubensis, Hispania (23 maii 2012; Prot. 274/12/L).

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the confraternity of the Holy Sepulchre and Our Lady of Sorrows of the archdiocese of Oviedo (Spain); an association's patron.
excerpt: Beatus Ioannes Paulus II, papa: Patronus caelestis sodalitii christifidelium a Sancta Seputura et a Domina Nostra Perdolenti archidioecesis Ovetensis, Hispania (24 maii 2012; Prot. 206/12/L).

summary_en: Vincent Ferrer, priest (printed 'Beatus' although he is a canonised saint), is confirmed as heavenly patron of the town of Teulada (archdiocese of Valencia, Spain); a single-town patron.
excerpt: Beatus Vincentius Ferrer, presbyter: Patronus caelestis civitatis Teuladae, Valentini, Hispania (25 maii 2012; Prot. 217/12/L).

celebration.name_latin: Beata Maria Virgo s. t. Dominae Nostrae a Luce

summary_en: The Blessed Virgin Mary under the title Our Lady of Light (Nuestra Señora de la Luz) is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the faithful of the town of Avilés (Abilium) and its district (archdiocese of Oviedo, Spain); a single-town patron.
excerpt: Beata Maria Virgo s. t. Dominae Nostrae a Luce: Patrona caelestis christifidelium civitatis Abilii eiusdemque pagi, Ovetensis, Hispania (26 maii 2012; Prot. 210/12/L).

summary_en: St Eulalia, virgin and martyr, is confirmed as heavenly patroness of the youth of the archdiocese of Mérida-Badajoz (Spain); a patron of a category of persons.
excerpt: Sancta Eulalia, virgo et martyr: Patrona caelestis iuventutis archidioecesis Eremitensis Augustanae Pacensis, Hispania (1 iun. 2012; Prot. 325/12/L).

summary_en: Blessed John Paul II, pope, is confirmed as heavenly patron of the town and commune of Oborniki (archdiocese of Poznań, Poland); a single-town patron.
excerpt: Beatus Ioannes Paulus II, Papa: Patronus caelestis urbis et communis v. d. Oborniki; Posnaniensis, Polonia (6 iun. 2012; Prot. 97/12/L).
